scope: Active apps/web/app/main.tsx -> CoreProvider -> PythonSession and WSProvider only; static source audit, no global coverage claim

auth_injection.onLogin: omitted; undefined in createAuthStore and AuthInitializer
auth_injection.renewal: CoreProvider token renewal branch is not created

workspace_chain.effects: cancel/remove queries locally, setCurrentWorkspace; slug change queues subscribers and registered rehydrators; cleanup clears identity
workspace_chain.ws: user + slug required; disconnect old connection; cookie upgrade to same-origin /ws?workspace_slug=...; no token auth frame in this mode
workspace_chain.rehydration_disposition: persist rehydrate reads workspace-namespaced localStorage; chat callback reads injected defaultStorage and sets memory; surface registry resets memory after hydration. No HTTP inside these registrations.

query_union_policy: Conservative static union of core query-factory methods, not assertion every candidate mounts or every invalidation sends. IDs/routes copied from existing inventory; query_factory_evidence identifies source candidates. Realtime reconnect and instance replacement invalidate matching workspace query prefixes.
local_effects: AuthInitializer unauthenticated effect calls clearClientSessionData: draft reset, localStorage sweep, cookie deletion, worker/IndexedDB wipe, queryClient.clear; none is HTTP
PythonSession cancelQueries/removeQueries are cache operations; invalidateQueries may refetch enabled observers

search-index hook attaches worker; client.runFetch dispatches getSearchIndexManifest/getSearchIndexSnapshot/getSearchIndexChanges with explicit workspaceSlug; prune/detach/wipe are local worker operations

dynamic_resources.classification: Returned arbitrary URL may become browser image I/O; slash values use API base; no fixed route identity inferred

limitations: Static conservative query union does not prove runtime mounting or backend support.
PostHog SDK delivery remains external analytics, not an invented backend route.
No desktop/mobile closure or global source coverage claimed.
